name: 蘑菇庄园（Mushroom Manor）
detailed_description:
Mushroom Manor is a casual idle farm game that sits at the bottom of your screen, offering gentle company as you work or study.

In the manor, you can purchase mushroom spores and cultivate adorable, whimsical mushrooms. Each mushroom carries a unique meaning and brings with it a heartfelt blessing.

You can fertilize, water, and remove pests to care for them as they grow. Of course, you can also hire little sprites and install beehives to help you manage your mushroom garden.

🌟 Mushroom Introductions 🌟

  • Flamelight Mushroom: Good fortune always, and a heart that burns bright
    The passionate fire within you never fades. Like the blazing glow of the Flamelight Mushroom, it drives away all gloom—each day is full of energy and courage, and everywhere you go becomes a warm little universe.

  • Twilight Shroom: Gentle dusk, serenity everlasting
    The gentleness of twilight always surrounds you. Like the soft halo of the Twilight Shroom, it brings calm and healing every evening, filling life’s quiet corners with poetry and beauty.

  • Glimmercap: Sparkling thoughts, wisdom in hand
    Even in dark corners, the Glimmercap’s gentle light shines your way. In loneliness, there is companionship; in confusion, there is clarity.

  • Shadowfungus: Secrets hidden, blessings revealed
    Surprises abound in your life. Hidden joys bloom from the unknown, and in calm days, you stumble upon delightful wonders. Every exploration brings unexpected happiness.

  • Nightlight Mushroom: Companion of the night, peaceful dreams
    You have a gentle harbor to rest in. When tired, there's a warm corner to lean on; when lonely, there's soft, adorable company. Every night is kissed softly by starlight.

  • Snowveil Cap: Snow sweeps the dust, immune to all ills
    Your world is as pure as fresh snow. Worries are brushed away by icy threads, heat is dispelled by coolness, and you embrace life with a heart forever pure.

  • Thornshade Shroom: Through thorns to the stars
    Protected by purple light and shielded by brambles, your armor is tenderness. You move forward without fear, yet never lose your warmth.

  • Crimson Pearl Mushroom: Honest heart, brilliance all around
    You shine like a precious gem. Confidence lights your path, and your energy never fades. Whatever you do, it radiates dazzling brilliance.

  • Venomkiss Mushroom: Immune to harm, evil repelled
    Your calm days hide a mischievous spark. Laughter and surprises never cease. Every moment is vivid and full of life.

  • Glassglow Shroom: Clear as crystal, loyal friends never part
    Your life shines like the seven-colored brilliance of the Glassglow Shroom. Beauty in your eyes, light in your heart—what you see is gentle, and where you walk is smooth.

  • Silentbloom Fungus: Quiet as heaven’s song, blooming within
    Inside you lies great strength. In solitude, you're not truly alone. In doubt, you find direction. The years leave you with only gentleness and resilience.

  • Frostveil Mushroom: Frost-honed will, blooming brilliance
    You're as clear and composed as frost. In heat, you find coolness; in chaos, you find calm. Every step of your journey blooms with flowers and reveals new scenery.

  • Blazefeather Mushroom: Passion ablaze, soaring high
    You're as fiery and free as a flame, soaring toward your dreams with passion that never dies. Every flight is a step toward your heart’s true desire.

  • Dreamweave Shroom: Dreams as silk, souls intertwined
    Good luck weaves sweet dreams for you. At night, there's a soft dreamland to return to; by day, courage to lean on. Every morning brings renewed energy and luck.

  • Skyshade Cap: Endless blue sky, bold dreams await
    The blue sky forever shields you. Everything you see is bright and hopeful. Worries drift away like clouds, and joy shines like eternal starlight.

  • Bluewave Mushroom: Walking the waves, boundless skies ahead
    The ocean and stars gift you with a vast heart. You meet challenges with calm like waves and clarity like stars. Each step is steady and free.

  • Moontide Shroom: Love’s ties endure, hearts intertwined
    Moonlight and lakewater nourish your soul—gentle as moonlight, enduring as flowing water. Life ripples with romance at every turn.

  • Charmkiss Mushroom: Naturally enchanting, turning heads everywhere
    Mystical blessings follow you. Every attempt is touched with luck, and every effort is loved by magic. Wherever you go, opportunity finds you.

  • Stardew Cap: Stars as companions, a dazzling path ahead
    The galaxy lights your journey. At night, stars guide your way; by day, courage protects you. Life is as radiant as the Milky Way, and every star is a shining dream.

  • Phantom Night Mushroom: Dazzling illusions, fortune ahead
    You will break free from the ordinary. Life becomes a dream of delightful surprises—each turn brings new wonders, and every day is your most beautiful yet!
